summary: U.S. GoldMining Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement that merely reduces the size of its existing at-the-market equity program with H.C. Wainwright (lead agent), Ventum Financial and Stifel, cutting the remaining offering to a maximum aggregate price of up to $3,200,000 of common stock under its May 2024 Sales Agreement. Roughly $11.4 million has already been sold, and about $5.22 million remains available under Form S-3 General Instruction I.B.6 caps. Public float was cited at $33.36 million; last sale $4.98 on November 5, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown adjustment, not a special situation.
